children: LME aluminium (MAL3=LX) may test a resistance at $3,356 per metric ton, a break above which could lead to a gain to $3,435.
The current rise is classified as an extension of the uptrend from $3,040. Riding on a wave c, the trend may extend far above the peak of the wave a at $3,385.
Support is at $3,274, a break below which may trigger a fall into the $3,179 to $3,228 range.
